jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat.  
**Qualification Required:** B.E./B.Tech only. Candidates from Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related technical branches preferred.  
**Experience:** 1 - 3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Reporting To:** CTO

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on **Full-Stack Software Engineer** to join BidVeda and help take our product from prototype to a production-ready B2B SaaS platform.

You will work directly with the CTO and take ownership of features across the **frontend, backend, APIs, database, cloud deployment and AI/LLM integrations**.  
This is an opportunity to work in an early-stage product environment where your technical decisions will directly shape the product and engineering practices.

**Key Skills**

* React / Next.js or similar frontend framework
* Node.js / Python or similar backend framework
* PostgreSQL / MySQL or similar database
* REST / GraphQL APIs
* AWS / GCP / Azure
* AI / LLM API integration
* Git and collaborative development
* Cloud deployment and CI/CD
* Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot

**Candidates who have built and deployed a complete product independently are preferred.**

**Please share your GitHub profile and links to live products/projects along with your resume.**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description:
* Design and build full-stack AI features, including tables, document-centric interfaces, review flows, and real-time or streaming interactions.
* Develop agentic systems with tool calling, multi-step workflows, RAG, and structured output handling.
* Build backend services using ASP.NET Core Web API and Python (FastAPI), and integrate them with React/Next.js frontends.
* Implement and improve RAG pipelines, covering chunking, embedding selection, vector store integration, and retrieval quality evaluation.
* Design AI-native UX patterns: confidence indicators, citations and source grounding, fallback states, edit/retry flows, and human review steps.
* Write evaluation tests before shipping new AI capabilities, using golden datasets, regression gates, and CI controls.
* Contribute to evaluation pipelines that combine deterministic metrics with LLM-as-judge approaches.
* Build systems that degrade gracefully when model outputs are unexpected.
* Manage context windows through token budgeting, truncation, and tool-call state persistence.
* Prototype quickly with AI tooling, then validate production artifacts against defined quality gates before promotion.

  
**Requirements**

**Education and experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years building production software, including full-stack applications and/or AI-enabled systems.
* Experience contributing to user-facing AI product features, from backend through frontend.
* Experience with agentic systems in production or pre-production (tool calling, multi-step workflows, RAG, structured outputs).
* Exposure to evaluation frameworks such as golden datasets, regression gates, or CI quality controls.

**Full-stack product engineering**

* Hands-on experience with .NET Core, ASP.NET Core Web API, SQL, and Microsoft technologies.
* Frontend skills in React and/or Next.js, TypeScript, component-based UI, API integration, and state management.
* Experience building tables, document-centric interfaces, review flows, or streaming experiences.
* Understanding of UX patterns for AI systems (confidence, citations, fallbacks, edit/retry, human review).

**AI platform engineering**

* Python proficiency, including FastAPI, Pydantic v2, async patterns, and pytest.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph: stateful graphs, tool integration, checkpointing, and streaming.
* Prompt engineering skills: structured output design, system prompt construction, and multi-turn context management.
* Experience with RAG pipelines and familiarity with vector databases such as pgvector and/or OpenSearch.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation: golden dataset design, metric definition, and regression gates.
* Awareness of context window management strategies.

**Generative AI and agentic systems**

* Regular use of AI coding assistants (Cursor, GitHub Copilot), with good judgement about where generated code is reliable and where it needs scrutiny.
* Familiarity with multi-agent concepts: orchestration logic, tool interfaces, and failure-handling patterns.

Send your resume along with your GitHub or portfolio link.

– Project-based learning

High-performing interns may be considered for future part-time or full-time opportunities at Nexvia Technologies based on their skills, performance and available opportunities.

jobs.title: Agentic AI Developer - Mumbai
jobs.description:
Urgent opening Agentic AI Developer - bhandup Mumbai

Agentic AI Developer Hands-on engineering for reliable, secure, production-ready AI agents. Location: Mumbai

Experience: 1–3 years

Joining: Immediate joiners

We are hiring developers who can build and debug AI agents and orchestration workflows, implement robust RAG, integrate tools/APIs, and help deliver secure, observable AI applications. Candidates must have personally built and tested working AI systems. Must-have Technical Skills **Python & backend: Strong practical Python, async programming, debugging, testing, FastAPI/Flask, REST APIs, JSON, authentication and Git.**  Agents & orchestration: Tool/function calling, multi-step workflows, agent state/context, multi-agent patterns, retries, timeouts, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop escalation. **RAG & retrieval: Embeddings, chunking, vector search, BM25, hybrid search, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), reranking, metadata filters, citations and retrieval evaluation.**  LLMs & MCP: Integrating OpenAI/Gemini/Claude or similar APIs, structured outputs, tool schemas, and MCP clients/servers or a clear understanding of how they work. **Guardrails & AI security: Input/output validation, prompt-injection risks, PII handling, access control, safe tool permissions and secrets management.**  Evaluation & reliability: Test datasets, regression tests, tracing/logging, hallucination checks, token/latency monitoring and error handling. Additional Valuable Skills **OCR & document AI: Scanned PDFs, OCR, layout/table extraction, document classification and structured extraction.**  SLMs & optimisation: Small Language Models, local inference, quantisation, model selection and cost/latency trade-offs. **Multimodal AI: Working with documents, images, audio or voice where relevant.**

**Deployment**: Docker, cloud deployment, streaming, concurrency and performance optimisation.

**What We Expect Candidates** must explain their own contribution to at least one working AI agent or RAG application, including architecture, orchestration, retrieval choices, failure handling and testing.

Tutorial-only exposure or prompt writing alone is not sufficient. Interview Process Technical discussion plus a practical exercise in Python, agent/tool orchestration, RAG retrieval and API integration.

call HR

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
